description: Looks up a trading term in Clear Tape's bilingual (English and Simplified Chinese) glossary of about 70 terms, such as "R multiple", "ATR", "drawdown" or "止损". Matches names, abbreviations and pinyin, and tolerates misspellings. Returns the definition, the term in the other language, close matches and links.

lang.description: Language of the returned text: "en" (default) or "zh" (Simplified Chinese).

term.description: The term to look up, in English or Chinese.

name: lookup_glossary_term
title: Trading glossary
